entities.summary: The Arab states of the Persian Gulf commonly referred to as the Gulf Arab states comprise Bahrain, Iraq, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the United Arab Emirates. These seven Arab states are grouped together on the basis of their boundary along the Persian Gulf, which touches the coast of every state in the Arabian Peninsula except for Yemen and Jordan.
